records.title: security(agent): bind repo exposure artifacts to provenance
records.release_claim: repair movement is computed only from typed, producer-bound repository artifacts
records.reason: This establishes repository, revision, input, schema, and content identity before static movement is trusted.
records.non_claim: Does not execute verification commands, sign artifacts, or prove correctness.

records.title: spec(receipt): separate assurance state axes
records.release_claim: static movement and executed verification are distinct evidence axes
records.reason: Omission would let static comparison language overstate command execution.
records.non_claim: Does not add a process runner or runtime mutation confirmation.

records.title: feat(agent): populate canonical command specs
records.release_claim: verification and receipt routes carry producer-owned typed command identity
records.reason: The gate, agent, and editor surfaces must not derive authoritative commands from display strings.
records.non_claim: A populated command specification is not evidence that the command ran.

records.title: feat(lsp): project typed command specs into repair actions
records.release_claim: editor repair actions project only validated producer-owned command routes
records.reason: This prevents request-side or diagnostic display fields from becoming command authority.
records.non_claim: Does not execute actions or issue receipts.

records.title: security(receipt): bind current head to repository
records.release_claim: canonical receipts record the repository HEAD observed by the writer
records.reason: Caller-supplied plausible SHAs cannot be treated as repository authority.
records.non_claim: HEAD binding alone does not validate every input artifact or execute verification.

records.title: fix(receipt): make default receipt paths portable for colon-delimited gap IDs
records.release_claim: default receipt paths work on supported platforms without changing canonical gap identity
records.reason: The documented repair loop must not generate invalid Windows file names or collisions.
records.non_claim: Does not strengthen receipt evidence content.

records.title: fix(receipt): bound long default paths
records.release_claim: default receipt storage stays within bounded portable path limits
records.reason: Portable path encoding still needs a bounded representation for long identities.
records.non_claim: Does not change the canonical receipt or gap identity.

records.title: feat(verify): add provenance-bound execution result contract
records.release_claim: an execution result can be validated against command, repository, revision, and output commitments
records.reason: The result contract is landed, but producer-controlled execution and RepairReceiptV2 remain open in #2332-#2334.
records.non_claim: 0.11.0 must not claim RIPR-executed verification unless the runner and issuance train lands.

records.title: fix(gap-ledger): carry producer seam identity into gate routes
records.release_claim: complete current full-scope gap-ledger routes can become policy-eligible through producer-owned identity
records.reason: This closes the hardcoded-missing-seam defect while keeping legacy or ambiguous rows advisory and fail-closed.
records.non_claim: Does not change default gate mode or promote preview evidence.

records.title: test(gate): pin command boundary outcomes
records.release_claim: explicit blocking mode returns a nonzero process result for a complete gap-ledger route
records.reason: The product claim requires command-level proof, not only unit-level eligibility.
records.non_claim: Generated CI remains advisory unless a repository explicitly configures blocking.

records.title: security(receipt): validate canonical verify input
records.release_claim: receipt issuance revalidates source artifacts and recomputes canonical static movement
records.reason: Hand-authored, altered, incomparable, or byte-different verify JSON must not become producer evidence.
records.non_claim: Does not execute proof commands or produce RepairReceiptV2.

records.title: security(receipt): bind current_head to actual git HEAD
records.release_claim: receipt write assertions are checked against the selected repository root
records.reason: This follow-up closes the explicit CLI path that could still accept an arbitrary formatted SHA.
records.non_claim: Does not replace the artifact provenance and canonical-input checks.
